dataset_uri.description: The validated dataset location (S3/HF/path) a downstream step trains on — the run's dataset_path, passed through (#579). Consumers should only train on it when verdict != 'fail'.
dataset_uri.title: Dataset Uri

blocking.description: Issues that must be fixed before training (each cites a check).
blocking.title: Blocking

checks_cited.description: The deterministic checks whose results informed this verdict.
checks_cited.title: Checks Cited

audit_metadata.description: Compact verdict record for the audit sink (blocking/warnings/thresholds).
audit_metadata.title: Audit Metadata

outcome.description: ADR-0075 run-level outcome metrics — the domain verdict + key check numbers as {name, value, pass, target}. Bound to $state.outcome so it surfaces on the standard output.outcome channel the pilot report / Playground read. Deterministic (mirrors the computed verdict); the LLM synthesis step never touches it.
outcome.title: Outcome
